baseGradient.assembly: Three large blurred layers; the third uses 50%-opacity color-dodge. The seven masked strips in Group-2131331001.svg reuse these same four angular color stops.

geometry.assembly: Each masked strip has three copies of the same angular gradient: two blurred layers and a third 50%-opacity color-dodge layer. Strip lengths and gradient transforms differ.

runtimeUse.surface: shared rear wall, MAX color region
runtimeUse.method: One independently colored moving strip per accepted event. The four authored stops are exact; a per-strip angle rotates one common Angular gradient, and each strip samples only a narrow sector of that large field.
runtimeUse.limitations: The SVG's huge Gaussian blur and color-dodge stack is preserved in the source file but is not a pixel-identical WebGL reproduction.
